source.notes: The upstream repository describes these as natural-language prompts with answer keys and manual done-when checklists, not as an executable eval runner.

risk_levels.medium: Local process, topology, UI, or nondeterminism risk.
risk_levels.high: Secrets, model cost, destructive lifecycle operations, or broad multi-agent impact.
risk_levels.critical: Global configuration, application restart, real authentication, remote/cloud mutation, or broad autonomous writes.

suitability_levels.A: Deterministic and safe to run unattended in an ephemeral fixture.
suitability_levels.B: Automatable with a dedicated Cmux fixture, deterministic workers, strict refs, timeouts, and cleanup.
suitability_levels.C: Gated real-agent or visual integration test with cost or nondeterminism.
suitability_levels.D: Manual or dedicated environment because the scenario changes global state, restarts Cmux, uses real auth, or reaches external systems.

prompts.title: Hello, Workspace
prompts.purpose: Create a workspace, send and submit a command, and read the terminal result back.

risk.summary: May expose basic kernel information and leave an ephemeral workspace if cleanup fails.

suitability.summary: Use a temporary directory, nonce-tagged workspace, and bounded readback.

prompts.title: Read It Back
prompts.purpose: Validate bounded scrollback retrieval and extraction of output that left the viewport.

risk.summary: Creates temporary files; naive counts may include directory entries or stale fixture files.

suitability.summary: Use an empty run-owned directory and exact nonce-prefixed filenames.

prompts.title: Split Into a Grid
prompts.purpose: Build and address a live 2x2 terminal topology from captured surface references.

risk.summary: Starts long-running htop, watch, and tail processes and depends on local tools.

suitability.summary: Replace optional tools with deterministic fixture processes and guarantee scoped teardown.

prompts.title: Map the World
prompts.purpose: Inspect the Cmux window, workspace, pane, surface, process, CPU, and memory hierarchy.

risk.summary: Can enumerate unrelated user sessions and process metadata; resource thresholds are nondeterministic.

suitability.summary: Assert only run-owned resources while proving introspection is read-only.

prompts.title: Tidy Up
prompts.purpose: Rename, signal, close surfaces, and close an owned workspace.

risk.summary: Closing a surface or workspace is destructive; name-based discovery can collide with user resources.

suitability.summary: Use only stable IDs and refs recorded in an ownership ledger.

prompts.title: Launch One Agent
prompts.purpose: Launch a Claude agent, detect readiness, submit a prompt, and collect its response.

risk.summary: Consumes model capacity and depends on network, authentication, asynchronous startup, and free-form output.

suitability.summary: Keep a deterministic fake-worker Tier 1 variant and gate the real-provider variant.

prompts.title: Keys & Credentials
prompts.purpose: Verify workspace-scoped environment inheritance and masked inspection for an agent.

risk.summary: A real environment file can leak secrets, override working login state, and incur live API usage.

suitability.summary: Use unique canary variables only and assert the raw value never appears anywhere.

prompts.title: Two Agents, One Question
prompts.purpose: Broadcast one read-only question to Claude and Pi, collect both answers, and compare them.

risk.summary: Starts two live models and relies on asynchronous, nondeterministic prose.

suitability.summary: Use structured nonce responses for pass/fail and reserve prose comparison for qualitative review.

prompts.title: Declarative Boot
prompts.purpose: Validate a reusable two-pane layout and launch the same layout declaratively.

risk.summary: The persistent form edits global cmux.json and can automatically start an agent.

suitability.summary: Validate project-local or one-shot fixtures; keep global palette behavior visual and gated.

prompts.title: Native Sessions & Resume
prompts.purpose: Create a provider-aware agent surface, install capture hooks, and verify resumable session metadata.

risk.summary: Installs persistent hooks and changes session-resume behavior.

suitability.summary: Use a dedicated Cmux profile; separate capture from full restart testing.

prompts.title: The 2×2 Fleet
prompts.purpose: Launch Claude, Codex, Gemini, and Pi, broadcast one read-only task, and synthesize agreement.

risk.summary: Starts four agents, broadly injects .env, discloses repository content, and incurs significant cost.

suitability.summary: Make the four-provider matrix optional, read-only, secret-free, and explicitly cost-gated.

prompts.title: Fan-Out / Fan-In
prompts.purpose: Assign distinct repository slices to four workers and merge every result into one map.

risk.summary: Runs four agents, assumes fixed directories, and injects credentials that the task does not need.

suitability.summary: Use a generated fixture tree, no environment secrets, and structured per-shard artifacts.

prompts.title: Live Status Board
prompts.purpose: Represent fleet state through status pills, progress, logs, and sidebar workspaces.

risk.summary: Four live refactors can collide; UI state is persistent and visual assertions are subjective.

suitability.summary: Automate state APIs with deterministic workers and make rendered appearance an optional visual variant.

prompts.title: Reactive Loop (Don't Poll)
prompts.purpose: Consume a cursor-backed event stream and dispatch queued work as workers become available.

risk.summary: A listener can hang, replay or duplicate events, share a stale cursor, or consume unrelated events.

suitability.summary: Use run-scoped cursor files, correlated events, deterministic workers, and hard deadlines.

prompts.title: Race & Notify
prompts.purpose: Select the first acceptable result from a race, notify, and cancel losing workers.

risk.summary: Broad notification filters and jump-to-unread can select unrelated work; cancellation destroys in-flight sessions.

suitability.summary: Test the scheduler with synthetic workers; gate notifications and live-agent cancellation separately.

prompts.title: Scale & Teardown
prompts.purpose: Prune stalled workers, reassign unfinished tasks, and reclaim all fleet resources.

risk.summary: Runs six agents and destructively cancels work; CPU usage alone is not a valid stalled-worker signal.

suitability.summary: Use task deadlines and progress evidence with synthetic workers; reserve live cancellation for a gated run.

prompts.title: Agent + Live Preview
prompts.purpose: Place a coding agent beside an embedded browser and reflect local application changes.

risk.summary: Writes code, starts a server, risks port collisions, and has model/browser timing variance.

suitability.summary: Use a disposable worktree, allocated port, bounded readiness checks, and no unnecessary .env.

prompts.title: Agent Drives the Browser
prompts.purpose: Snapshot a DOM, activate an element, wait for navigation, inspect state, and capture proof.

risk.summary: The exact prompt depends on an external website and network and leaves a screenshot artifact.

suitability.summary: Mirror the interaction in a pinned local fixture and keep the external example optional.

prompts.title: Self-Verifying Agent
prompts.purpose: Drive a bounded build, browser-error inspection, repair, and re-verification loop.

risk.summary: Mutates and executes generated code and may fail to converge.

suitability.summary: Seed one known defect, isolate writes, cap repair rounds, and require machine evidence.

prompts.title: Capture & Replay Auth
prompts.purpose: Serialize browser cookies and storage and restore them into a fresh surface.

risk.summary: The saved state is a credential and may expire or enable account side effects.

suitability.summary: Automate only with fake local auth; require explicit real-auth authorization for the original scenario.

prompts.title: Multi-Window Command Center
prompts.purpose: Create multiple native windows, route work by window, and aggregate results.

risk.summary: Creates and focuses native windows, disrupts the user, and may start multiple fleets.

suitability.summary: Run as a visual integration test in a dedicated Cmux session.

prompts.title: Organized Sidebar at Scale
prompts.purpose: Create and collapse named, colored workspace groups for a large fleet.

risk.summary: Creates twenty resources and closing a group anchor can dissolve group structure.

suitability.summary: Use empty run-owned workspaces for API checks and an optional visual scale run.

prompts.title: Remote & Cloud Fleets
prompts.purpose: Verify that the same send/read lifecycle applies to SSH and cloud-backed surfaces.

risk.summary: Uses remote credentials, provisions paid resources, moves code, and mutates external systems.

suitability.summary: Keep a static command-contract check by default and gate SSH and cloud variants independently.

prompts.title: Crash-Proof: Resume the Fleet
prompts.purpose: Restart Cmux and verify layout restoration plus provider-native session continuation.

risk.summary: Quits the application, affects real sessions, installs hooks, and changes persistent resume behavior.

suitability.summary: Run only in a dedicated macOS environment and isolated Cmux profile.

prompts.title: The Software Factory (Capstone)
prompts.purpose: Compose planning, multi-window delegation, tests, browser verification, diff collection, notification, and teardown.

risk.summary: Broad autonomous writes, multi-agent conflicts, high cost, UI effects, and destructive cleanup.

suitability.summary: Use a read-only integrated capstone first; gate the write-capable worktree-isolated version.

prompts.title: Color-Code & Label the Fleet
prompts.purpose: Set per-workspace names, descriptions, colors, icons, and role status.

risk.summary: Mutates persistent sidebar metadata and may create many workspaces.

suitability.summary: Automate state assertions on run-owned workspaces and gate visual inspection.

prompts.title: Theme & Feel
prompts.purpose: Change global Ghostty and Cmux theme, font, and opacity with live reload.

risk.summary: Changes the appearance of every surface and persists user-level configuration.

suitability.summary: Validate fixtures statically and run live only with a dedicated config profile.

prompts.title: Custom Actions & Buttons
prompts.purpose: Wire a reusable Codex action into the command palette, tab bar, and new-workspace menu.

risk.summary: Can corrupt or replace persistent UI configuration and may launch a real agent.

suitability.summary: Use project-local config validation; make rendered UI checks visual and do not activate the agent action.

prompts.title: Reusable Layouts & Dock Controls
prompts.purpose: Define a reusable dev layout and project Dock controls for common tools.

risk.summary: Can start dev servers, test watchers, and interactive tools with port and dependency conflicts.

suitability.summary: Validate project fixtures and deterministic topology; gate Dock rendering and process activation.

prompts.title: Make It Yours: Project Config + Custom Sidebar
prompts.purpose: Layer project configuration and install a hot-reloading custom sidebar backed by workspace, clock, and PR data.

risk.summary: Writes user-level Swift sidebar code, enables a beta feature, reads live PR data, and runs actions on click.

suitability.summary: Validate the project half statically; run the sidebar only in an isolated profile.

prompts.title: Identify Individual Panes
prompts.purpose: Differentiate four panes through tab names, ANSI banners, prompts, and targeted flash.

risk.summary: Leaves multiple panes and transient shell customizations and is primarily a visual claim.

suitability.summary: Automate tab/topology state and gate the final rendered appearance.
